_doc: LANCE-19 batch 2: Praetorian Mobile HQ (RGriffin65). Front axle steers, two rear wheels; the radar dish is a separate part.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 2, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. WHEELED. The kit's front wheels and module labels were merged into the hull, the front wheel pair and two rear wheels (`wheel_l0`..`wheel_r2`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`) on axles fitted to the kit; the front pair is under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0`. The radar dish and its post (`hq_radar`, on node hq_radar under the stand) is a separate part; the kit's leaning post is split at z 4200: the neck below stays with the hull, the dish and yoke above are `hq_radar`. It spins at 40 deg/s (`spin` in the sidecar, written from `mobilehq_prep.json`) about the vertical axis through the dish's own centre (490, -725 mm). Needle triangles dropped; welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse.
